photos.desc: Eurasian sparrowhawk (Accipiter nissus) female standing by a puddle and looking at a photographer. Samica krogulca (Accipiter nissus) stojąca koło kałuży i patrząca na fotografa.
One from the archives; seen in my garden in August 2008. Perched in my garden, after a kill in my neighbour's garden.
Épervier d'Europe ( Accipiter nisus ) à Périgueux, Dordogne, France.
